cyborg-x.character: Cyborg X / female Cape Jones (Alisa Bosconovitch)
cyborg-x.notes: Pieces are modeled in place at her coordinates — socket attach with zero offsets, no re-fit needed.

coordinate_system: All four pieces modeled IN PLACE at Alisa's real coordinates from game/assets/models/cyborg-x.glb: eye centers (±0.026, 1.364, 0.055), face front Z≈0.06, forearms Y≈1.178 Z≈−0.035. Drop them onto cyborg-x as-is; on other characters attach at the registry socket with fit=headHeight auto-scale (see customization/PARTS-REGISTRY.json).

how_to_attach: 1. Pick a part entry; load its .glb.
2. attach(character, entry.socket, pieceScene, { manifest: { socket: { bone_aliases: entry.bone_aliases } }, edit: entry offsets }) — see packages/creation-suite/src/attire.js.
3. On cyborg-x: offsets are zero by design. On any other character: pass fit={ headHeight } so the piece auto-scales to that character's head.
4. Color edits: applyEdit tints (roughness/metalness included). Detach swaps back instantly — nothing on the character is overwritten.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-17/2026-10-18: original-geometry attachable 3D pieces for the Cape Jones build; wiring 2026-10-18 into the Creation Suite parts registry.
